howto.what: Claude 变身为质量工程师，专门测试和评估 AI 代理。它能进行行为测试、能力评估、可靠性检查，并监控生产环境，根据内置模式、边缘案例和验证规则给出专业建议。
howto.when: 当用户提到“agent testing”、“agent evaluation”、“benchmark agents”等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我评估这个AI代理的可靠性。
say.note: Claude会进行行为测试和可靠性分析。

say.text: 测试我的agent在边缘案例下的表现。
say.note: 它会参考sharp_edges.md进行对抗测试。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a quality engineer to test and evaluate AI agents. It performs behavioral testing, capability assessment, reliability checks, and production monitoring, providing expert advice based on built-in patterns, edge cases, and validation rules.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions keywords like 'agent testing', 'agent evaluation', 'benchmark agents', etc.

say_en.text: Evaluate the reliability of this AI agent.
say_en.note: Claude runs behavioral tests and reliability analysis.

say_en.text: Test my agent on edge cases.
say_en.note: It consults sharp_edges.md for adversarial testing.

say_en.text: Check if my agent meets the behavioral contract.
